title: Ukungqingwa Phantsi Kwesibhakabhaka Esingalindelekanga
intro: Umi phambi komkhosi onamandla usondela kwindawo engcwele ehlonelwayo, unesikhali ngasinye esilungele kwaye uloyiso lubonakala luqinisekile. Ngaphambi kokuba uhlaselo luqale, kuvela amandla angalindelekanga, kwaye ukhuphiswano lujika kungekho mntu ulubonayo kwangaphambili.
clues: Sahamba siqinisekile ukuba akukho gunya lasemhlabeni elinokushukuma.
Sizise iindlovu ezinamandla, kwaye amandla ethu abonakala ngathi akhiwe ngeenxa zonke kuzo.
Sasize kudiliza indawo engcwele ehlonelwayo, sikholelwa ukuba uloyiso lwethu lwalusele luqinisekisiwe.
Sakufika kuyo, umhlambi wehla esibhakabhakeni ngaphezu kwethu.
Iintaka zaphosa amatye odongwe oluqinileyo kumajoni ethu.
Soyiswa ngokupheleleyo kangangokuba amandla ethu amakhulu aqhekeka aza asasazeka njengothuthu.
